name: Lantern Rite, Big Business?
description: Mr. Zhu seems to want to use the Lantern Rite to pick his business up a little...

steps.description: Talk to Mr. Zhu
Collect two sets of Xiao Lantern materials
Collect two sets of Xiao Lantern materials
Give Xiao Lantern materials to Dummy
Give Delicious Jewelry Soup to Mr. Zhu
Hang the Xiao Lantern on one side of the inn's door
Hang the Xiao Lantern on the other side of the inn's door
Talk to Dummy
Talk to Mr. Zhu
Send out invitations to nearby people
Send out invitations to the people in the area
Report back to Mr. Zhu
Cook a Delicious Jewelry Soup
Take a seat by the table
Talk to Mr. Zhu
Talk to Jianqiu
Escort the two to a high point to release the Xiao Lantern
Escort the two to a high point to release the Xiao Lantern
Talk to Mr. Zhu

dialogs.content: There must be a way...
A way to do what?
Oh, it's you, Traveler. You know how it's the time of the Lantern Rite, right? Well, I was trying to think of a way to help give my business a bit of a boost during all the festivities.
Good location, nice scenery, and food... we've got plenty of that, too.
I can see it now...They'll release the Mingxiao Lantern in the city, and here we've got tasty food, plenty to drink, and an incredible view — it's going to be spectacular!
This'll be my main selling point to attract more customers. What do you think?
Will you really be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here?
Uh, of course you can see it from here... The lantern's so big that you'll certainly be able to see part of it, at least.
Anyway, we'll get to that when the time comes. First, I need to get the inn squared away for more guests.
Traveler, could I trouble you to collect some Xiao Lantern-making materials? I would like to hang some around the inn.
I might as well assemble the lanterns while I'm at it...
All I need are the materials. Constructing the lanterns can be quite time-consuming.
So once you've collected the materials, just give them to Dummy and he'll take care of the rest. I'll be attending to other matters in the meantime.
Of course, I won't be letting you leave empty-handed. I'll be sure you're rewarded after some guests come and business picks up.
And if there's no guests...
Uh, well... Even if no guests show up, I'll still have something prepared for you. Don't worry about that.
I'm sure more guests will start to arrive once the inn is put in good order.
*cough* Just pass those materials to Dummy. I'll finalize your payment tomorrow based on the situation.
Only the materials?
There's no way you'll be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here...
We really won't be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here?
We'll need to make more Xiao Lanterns...
I need to go attract some guests. I'll give you your rewards a little later.
Hmm... Minghua Bank... Minghua Bank.
Thanks — I was just beginning to worry that we'd run out of materials.
Just give me a moment to make a few more Xiao Lanterns and we can hang them all up together.
...And that should just about do it. Here, take these Xiao Lanterns and hang them beside the doors to the inn.
I still need to make a few more lanterns in case we need them later.
Hmm, I think I'll still need to make a few more Xiao Lanterns...
About materials for the Xiao Lanterns...
Oh right, you can just give the materials to me. I'll take it from here.
Very strange indeed... Still no guests.
I appreciate your kind offer, but I'm afraid that I cannot abandon my post while I'm on duty.
Please hurry with the Delicious Jewelry Soup. It's hard enough to get guests as it is, we mustn't disappoint them.
Strange, very strange indeed. I wonder what the matter is...
What's wrong?
Hardly any guests came at all yesterday... How could that be? There should be loads of travelers for the festival...
Maybe it's because hardly anyone ever passes through here...
No, that can't be it... There must be something wrong with the way I'm trying to attract guests.
Perhaps it'd be better if I attracted guests more directly...
Traveler, could you please go around and attract some guests for me?
You can mention that we have good food, nice rooms, and an excellent view for the Lantern Rite festival.
I'll keep thinking if there are any other ways we can attract some guests...
I doubt there'd be many people traveling outside during the Lantern Rite...
Hello. Please wait while we perform a routine inspection.
Would you like to stay at Mr. Zhu's inn?
Oh? Yes, I have in fact heard about Mr. Zhu's inn.
But I'm on duty now. I appreciate your kind offer, but I'm afraid I cannot just abandon my post.
Hmm? What is it, youngster?
Would you like to stay at Mr. Zhu's inn?
Oh, Mr. Zhu... Yes, I know the place.
But I'm afraid that his inn is simply too far from here. These old legs couldn't handle such a journey, sorry.
Sorry, the inn is simply too far from here. These old legs couldn't handle such a journey.
Good work, Traveler. Please, have a seat and join us.
I'm sorry, it's just that I...
Don't say that. Let's just enjoy watching the Xiao Lanterns while we still may...
This would actually be a very suitable place to release the Xiao Lantern. Thank you, Traveler.
You're welcome.
I just hope... that her wish will come true.
Thank you, Traveler. We should be on our way now.
So, is the food ready?
It certainly is.
Okay, great. These are all the dishes we needed. Thank you.
Sorry to keep you waiting, hehe. Here's your food, please enjoy.
#Thank you, Mr. Zhu. Also, this Traveler has gone to great lengths to help with everything. We'd be delighted if {M#he}{F#she} could join us.
Thanks.

Hehe, judging from your appearance, you must also be a traveler on some distant journey. The festival makes for a fitting time for people to come together, share a meal, and enjoy a lively time with one another.
Yes. In fact, would you also care to join us, Mr. Zhu?
Oh, uh... Yes, I—I'd be delighted.

We still need to make a few Xiao Lanterns, but we're missing <color=#00E1FFFF>two Lantern Fibers</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>two Wick Materials</color>. The boss says that he'll think of something, though...
Right this way, please. Everything's already been prepared, so please have a seat.
Mr. Zhu, who are these two...
Ah yes, I was just out attracting guests when I ran into these two.
That's right, this lady is from Minghua Bank, and I'm one of the bank employees.
The lady and I were just setting off on a distant journey at the start of the Lantern Rite. I'm afraid she feels a little homesick...
So we decided to find a spot to watch the Xiao Lanterns, which is when we happened to meet Mr. Zhu.
Yes, and it just so happens that we've just prepared new Xiao Lanterns for the inn. Hmm... was it Minghua Bank you said? Does that mean—
Ahem, I shan't pry.
You two must be exhausted from your journey. Please have a rest while we prepare some food for you.
Traveler, could you lend us a hand again? We'll need to quickly prepare some food for our two guests.
Please prepare a serving of Delicious Jewelry Soup. I'll be sure to compensate you accordingly once things are all settled.
Thank you for your service. Here's some Mora, please check the amount.
Sure thing. This Mora will be plenty. Now, will you two travelers be continuing further on your journey, or will you return to the city?
I've heard that the Mingxiao Lantern will be particularly impressive this year.
We...
We'll be sure to go see it if we get the chance. Thanks for letting us know, Mr. Zhu.
Excuse me, Mr. Zhu. Would you be willing to sell us one of your Xiao Lanterns?
Even if we don't get the opportunity to see the Mingxiao Lantern in the city, it would still be nice to release a Xiao Lantern, right?
Yes, it is the Lantern Rite after all.
Sure, no problem at all! I just happen to have a few new Xiao Lanterns that were just made today.
Here, you may have this lantern free of charge. It is the Lantern Rite after all, you may keep your Mora.
Thank you, Mr. Zhu. Do you know of a suitable place to release the lantern nearby?
A place to release a Xiao Lantern, huh? Let me think, it should somewhere higher up... Ah yes, I remember that there should be some suitable places if you follow this road further up the mountain.
However, there's been word of monsters appearing on the mountain, so you two should be careful.
Traveler, I'm sorry to trouble you, but... Would you be willing to escort us up the mountain to release the Xiao Lantern?
You can count on me.
My apologies. I'm afraid we cannot return to the city at this time because of... certain matters.
As such, we'll require your protection on the mountain. We can leave whenever you're ready.
After we release the Xiao Lantern, we'll continue on our way.
Why don't you return to the city?
Ah, you're back. *sigh* It's been difficult to attract guests during the festival...
Huh, what about the two guests that were here earlier? Have they left already?
Yes, they've continued on their journey.
Oh, I see... Leaving on a journey during the Lantern Rite mustn't be easy for them.

Huh, now that you mention it... Regardless of whether they were heading towards or away from Liyue, don't you find it a little strange that they continued their journey without stopping for the night?
When I met them earlier, it was clear from their expressions that they didn't know which way to go.
They even jumped when I called after them, and there was something a bit off about their attire as well...
Oh, forget about it... Here's the compensation I'd promised you earlier.
Thanks for all your help. I'll get back to matters at the inn now.
